title: MoodState
description: mood (since 1.10): her mood now and how it shows on her face. The server sends it when a node has sent its manifest, and each time her mood changes (the daily roll, the user switches it, she chooses it with her set_mood function, the user edits the mood). A node shows the face as a soft expression on her body; an animation's own face and her state (asleep) win over it. A node may ignore the frame.

mood.description: The key of the mood, null before her first chat of the day.

name.description: Its name, for a node that shows it.

expression.description: The expression on her face: happy, sad, angry, relaxed or surprised; null for none. A node ignores a value it does not know.

weight.description: How strong the expression is, 0 to 1; null for none.

eyes.description: Her eyes in this mood: half (half closed) or wide (open wide, never blinking); null for open and blinking.
